items.text: People on this team can admit mistakes without fear of blame.
People on this team feel safe raising concerns about work-related problems.
People on this team can ask for help without feeling judged.
People on this team feel comfortable suggesting new ways of doing things.
People on this team are criticized when they disagree with others.
People on this team are made to feel foolish when they ask questions.
People on this team risk being excluded when they express unpopular opinions.
